input.title: 2023 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 12 180
input.descriptionHtml:
Financing Available!*

Book a FREE On-Water Demo!


Dominate the water, fresh or salt. The Pro Angler 12 deploys all the big-boat fishing features of the 'PA' series on a 12-ft. long platform that fits neatly in the bed of most any pickup truck. Keep a half-dozen rods rigged and ready in the four standard horizontal and two molded-in rod holders. Confidently stand and fire, cast after cast. The elevated Vantage ST seat makes it easy to move around the boat.  You'll love the retractable skeg for improved course-keeping, as well as the innovative H-Rail for superior flexibility in accessory rigging.
 

Length: 12' / 3.66 m
Width: 36" / .91 m
Hull Weight: 105 lbs / 48 kg
Fully Rigged Weight: 128.5 lbs / 58 kg
Capacity: 500 lbs / 227 kg
Vantage Seat Capacity:  350 lbs / 159 kg
Crew:  1
